[[Professor/Legends|Professor]] '''H. Hrush''' was an individual who was the [[Author/Legends|author]] of a [[Book/Legends|book]] entitled ''[[The Lost Twenty: Dooku's Rise]]'', though it was published without consent from the proper parties. The book concerned a [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] named [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]],<ref name="News">{{HoloNetNewsWeb|45||A Closer Look}}</ref> who [[Lost Twenty/Legends|resigned]] from the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] to found a [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|militarized confederacy]] of [[Planet/Legends|worlds]] that wished to secede from the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].<ref name="The New Essential Chronology">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> For a [[Time/Legends|time]]<ref name="News" /> in [[23 BBY/Legends|23 BBY]],<ref name="Date">{{HoloNetNewsWeb|45||A Closer Look}} is set on the date 13:2:28, which corresponds to [[23 BBY/Legends|23 BBY]] according to the reasoning [[Template:YearMathGRS|here]].</ref> Hrush's book was listed as the number-two best-selling book on a list published by the [[HoloNet News CoCo District Edition|CoCo District Edition]] of [[HoloNet News/Legends|HoloNet News]] on the [[Great ReSynchronization|date]] 13:2:28.<ref name="News" />

==Behind the scenes==
H. Hrush was mentioned in [[HoloNet News Vol. 531 45|''HoloNet News Vol. 531 #45'']], an [[in-universe]] issue of the HoloNet news published on the [[HoloNet News (original website)|HoloNet News website]]<ref name="News" /> on [[February 28]], [[2002]].<ref name="HNN45 date">Per {{JCFCite|url=posts/6042498|board=Literature|thread=The Official HoloNetNews Discussion Thread|user=IAmTheDarkSide|date=2002-03-14|time=5:40 PM|archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20220914072556/https://boards.theforce.net/threads/the-official-holonetnews-discussion-thread.5990764/page-4#post-6042498}}, [[HoloNet News Vol. 531 47|''HoloNet News Vol. 531'' #47]] was released on [[March 14]], [[2002]]. As [[HoloNet News (original website)|HoloNet News]] segments were published weekly, and {{Hnn|45||A Closer Look}} was published two issues prior, it must have been released on [[February 28]] of the same year.</ref> The site's content was written by [[Pablo Hidalgo]] and [[Paul Ens]].<ref name="HNN Credits">{{HoloNetNewsWeb||credits.html|Credits}}</ref>
